description: This file defines the DistributedSub interface, which provides methods for managing pub-sub subscriptions and acknowledgements in a distributed system, specifically for the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DistributedSub
classes.description: Interface for pub-sub subscription management in a distributed environment, including subscribing, unsubscribing, and acknowledgment label declaration.

methods.name: subscribeWithFilterAndAck
methods.description: Subscribe to topics with a local filter and receive acknowledgment upon success.

methods.name: subscribeWithAck
methods.description: Subscribe to topics and receive acknowledgment upon success.

methods.name: subscribeWithoutAck
methods.description: Subscribe to topics without waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: unsubscribeWithoutAck
methods.description: Unsubscribe from topics without waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declare acknowledgment labels for a subscriber.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Remove acknowledgment label declaration for a subscriber.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Create a DistributedSub instance from a distributed data configuration and a sub-supervisor actor.
